dairy_farming.data_source: Agmarknet Dairy Cell & State Milk Federation Procurements
dairy_farming.recommended_pricing_strategy: Cost-Plus with Premium for Freshness (Target ₹52-55/L for doorstep delivery to outprice urban packaged milk)

poultry_farming.data_source: National Egg Coordination Committee (NECC) & State Poultry Rates
poultry_farming.recommended_pricing_strategy: Direct Farm Gate Discount (Offer 5% below town retail stalls to capture local village demand)

rural_kirana_retail.data_source: Retailers Association of India (RAI) Rural Grocery Benchmarks
rural_kirana_retail.recommended_pricing_strategy: Everyday Fair Price with bundled micro-banking service convenience

tailoring_garments.data_source: State Handloom & Handicrafts Board Sample Survey
tailoring_garments.recommended_pricing_strategy: Tiered Pricing (Base simple stitch at market rate + Premium add-on for express 24h delivery)

agro_processing_mill.data_source: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) Rural Cluster Unit
agro_processing_mill.recommended_pricing_strategy: Volume-discounted milling + High-margin proprietary spice brand

two_wheeler_workshop.data_source: Automotive Skills Development Council (ASDC) Micro-Garage Survey
two_wheeler_workshop.recommended_pricing_strategy: Standard diagnostic rate + 20% margin on genuine spares
